policy.profile_source: Independent remake ratings inferred from recorded roles; not SAN14 values or historical measurements.
policy.birth_and_service_precision: Explicit per-field estimates remain estimates; ancient texts seldom supply exact service dates.
policy.unknown_death: No invented historical death date. retirement_year is an authorial gameplay boundary mapped separately by builder.
policy.membership: Windows are authored playable eligibility grounded in dated career records; city mappings are regional proxies, not exact monthly garrisons. No force spawn outside windows.
policy.dedup: Original1000 name/alias comparison plus semantic review of family names, variant characters and biographies. 施績/朱績 and 荀勖/荀勗 are existing identities, not additions.
